locations.name: Bellwold Market Square
locations.description:
Stalls and handcarts crowd the open ground. The smell of baked bread drifts from the east side of the square.

The tower road rises north and South Common lies south. A lane leads west toward the Kindly Roof; Marr’s General Goods is east.

locations.name: The Kindly Roof
locations.description: Firelight warms the common room, and low voices drift between the tables. A trace of smoke clings to the rafters. The market square lies east; a narrow road leaves west.

locations.name: Bellwold West Gate
locations.description: The western lane passes the last village fences and a simple timber gate. The Kindly Roof is east; the westbound road runs past the hedgerows.

locations.name: Westbound Track
locations.description: The packed-earth road follows low hedgerows beyond Bellwold’s western fields. The West Gate is east; the rough road end is west.

locations.name: Western Road Verge
locations.description: The packed track narrows between scrub and open ground. A rutted farm road carries on west beside a drainage ditch toward Harrowfen’s fields; West Gate lies back to the east.

locations.name: Harrowfen Road Ditch
locations.description: The farm road runs beside a straight drainage ditch. Cart wheels have cut the bank, and the mud near the reeds is churned by something heavier. Flat fields open to the west; the Western Road Verge is east.

locations.name: East Field Gate
locations.description: A field gate stands open where the road meets Harrowfen’s first strips of grain and flax. Low fields stretch away under a wide sky. The threshing green is west; the road back to Bellwold runs east.

locations.name: Threshing Green
locations.description: A beaten circle of shared ground is swept clear for threshing, with flails stacked against a post. The weigh-house is north, a drainage cut runs south, and the tenant cottages line the way west. The field gate is east.

locations.name: Weigh-House
locations.description: A squat timber house holds a heavy beam scale and a board of chalked tallies. Sacks wait by the door to be weighed. The threshing green is south.

locations.name: Drainage Cut
locations.description: A long channel drains the low fields. Its sides are freshly recut in places and slumped in others, as if no two seasons agreed on how the water should run. The threshing green is north.

locations.name: Tenant Row
locations.description: Small cottages face the lane, each with a patched roof and tools hung by the door. The people who work the fields live here; most of the land beyond belongs to others. The threshing green is east and the west fields lie beyond.

locations.name: West Fields
locations.description: Strips of grain, root crops and flax run toward the horizon, divided by ditches and a weathered boundary stone carved with an estate mark. Tenant Row is east.

locations.name: Marr’s General Goods
locations.description: Provision jars line the shelves. Near the counter, a balance scale sits beside an open ledger; a brass weight glints in the window light.

locations.name: Bellwold South Common
locations.description: Benches stand beside drying lines and a bulletin board. Voices and footsteps carry across the grass. The market square is north, the Green Mortar west, Blackwater Forge east, and Well Court south.

locations.name: The Green Mortar
locations.description: Bundles of dried plants hang above a workbench; clean cloth is folded near a shallow bowl. The sharp scent of crushed herbs lingers in the air. The open green is east; Wattle Row is south.

locations.name: Blackwater Forge
locations.description: Tongs and hammers hang over a dark stone hearth. Half-mended iron pieces rest on the bench, and coal smoke clings to the beams. South Common lies west.

locations.name: Bellwold Well Court
locations.description:
A stone-rimmed well and a broad trough give this quiet court a steady rhythm of buckets, footsteps, and short conversations. A covered storehouse stands to the east; Wattle Row branches west.

South Common is north, and the Common House is south.

locations.name: Wattle Row
locations.description: Low homes and work yards line a narrow lane. Pale new strips weave through the older, darkened reeds of the wattle walls. The Green Mortar is north, Well Court east, a wheelwright’s yard west, and Tallow End Cottage south.

locations.name: Soven’s Wheelwright Yard
locations.description: A turning frame, wooden spokes, and a rack of finished rims fill this fenced yard. Shavings gather in the corners despite the broom leaning by the gate; the sound of a saw carries from the south.

locations.name: Tallow End Cottage
locations.description:
A narrow cottage opens onto Wattle Row. A loom stands beside the window, with folded cloth kept clear of the hearth and a basket of mending beside the door.

Wattle Row is north; the Common House is east.

locations.name: Old Grain House
locations.description: A timber storehouse stands on a raised stone sill; narrow vent gaps cut the upper walls. Chalk marks cross the faces of several storage bins. Well Court is west.

locations.name: Bellwold Common House
locations.description: A long timber room holds a scuffed table and mismatched benches. Paper notices cover one wall, and fresh ink smells sharp near the record book. Well Court is north, Tallow End Cottage is west, and the south road leaves town beyond the last yards.

locations.name: Bellwold South Gate
locations.description: The last cluster of village yards gives way to a low gate and a packed-earth road. The Common House is north; the southbound track continues south.

locations.name: Hearth Alley
locations.description: Close-set walls cast a narrow strip of shade across the lane. A cooking fire crackles behind one shutter.

locations.name: Lantern Court
locations.description: A dented iron lantern hangs above the lane, and rainwater darkens the stones beneath it.

locations.name: Nettlemere House
locations.description: A copper kettle rattles softly above the hearth, and the kitchen smells of warm bread.

locations.name: Upper Row House
locations.description: A handloom clicks beside a sunlit window. Wool fibers cling to the rough boards.

locations.name: Lower Row
locations.description: A loose shutter taps in the breeze; damp earth darkens the packed lane.

locations.name: Lower Row House
locations.description: A saw scrapes across a plank, scattering pale curls over the workbench.

locations.name: South Lower Row
locations.description: Packed earth gives way to a patch of worn stone. A dog barks behind a fence.

locations.name: South Lane Cottage
locations.description: A clay pot of thyme sits on the sill; its sharp scent reaches through the open window.

locations.name: Bellwold Jail
locations.description: Iron bars cast thin shadows across the stone floor. Keys clink briefly behind the desk.

locations.name: Jail Holding Cell
locations.description: A narrow barred door stands across from the stone wall. Damp straw smells sour in the close air.

locations.name: Bellwold Library
locations.description: Books and stitched pamphlets fill the shelves around a broad reading table. Dry paper and lamp oil mingle in the air.

locations.name: Upper Reading Room
locations.description: A long window fills the sloped room with pale light. Pages rustle softly in the draft.

locations.name: Bellwold Local Museum
locations.description: Glass-fronted cases stand against the walls. A slate tally board and a faded waterwheel sketch sit beneath a dusty window.

locations.name: Southbound Track
locations.description:
Wind stirs the grass as Bellwold’s roofs recede north; deer prints mark the softer earth.

The South Gate is north; the reedbed approach lies south.

locations.name: Reedbed Approach
locations.description:
Damp grass brushes the road’s edges, and reeds rustle along the riverbanks. The current deepens toward the stone bridge to the south, and a towpath follows the north bank west toward Rillford.

The Southbound Track is north; Lower Rill Bridge is south.

locations.name: Lower Rill Bridge
locations.description: A low stone bridge carries the south road over the Lower Rill. The current runs east and west beneath its arches. Reedbed Approach is north; Far Bank Track is south.

locations.name: West Reach
locations.description: The current passes the bridge piers and slides west beneath the reeds. The bridge lies east; Willow Reach is west.

locations.name: Willow Reach
locations.description: Willow roots trail into the slow water along this stretch. West Reach is east; Far West Reach is west.

locations.name: Far West Reach
locations.description: The river broadens beyond the western reedbeds. Willow Reach is east; Reed Reach is west.

locations.name: East Reach
locations.description: The current emerges from beneath the bridge and runs east through reeds and shallow stones. The bridge lies west; Alder Reach is east.

locations.name: Alder Reach
locations.description: A line of alder trees shadows this stretch of water. East Reach is west; Far East Reach is east.

locations.name: Far East Reach
locations.description: The water curves around an alder-lined bank. Alder Reach lies west; tall sedge marks another bend to the east.

locations.name: Reed Reach
locations.description: Tall reeds crowd both banks and lean over the slow water. A towpath shows along the north bank. Far West Reach is east; Towpath Reach is west.

locations.name: Towpath Reach
locations.description: The river runs close beside the towpath here, and rope-worn posts stand along the north bank. Reed Reach is east; Rillford’s ferry stage lies west.

locations.name: Ferry Stage
locations.description: A timber stage reaches out over the Lower Rill on tarred piles. Boats tie up along its edge to load and unload, and crews keep an eye on the current while they work. Rillford’s south landing lies across the water; passage over is arranged with the boat crews, and none is taking passengers now. The north quay is north.

locations.name: West of Rillford
locations.description: Beyond Rillford’s ferry stage the river widens and runs on out of sight. Nobody here has marked where it goes. The ferry stage lies east.

locations.name: Towpath Willow Bank
locations.description: A worn towpath leaves the south road and follows the river’s north bank under leaning willows. Reedbed Approach is east; the towpath runs on west.

locations.name: Towpath Mooring Posts
locations.description: Old mooring posts stand along the bank, their tops grooved by rope. The water runs deep enough here to drop a line. The towpath runs east and west.

locations.name: Towpath Sedge Flats
locations.description: Sedge flats spread between the towpath and the water, cut by narrow channels. Something heavy has rooted along the margin. The towpath runs east and west.

locations.name: Towpath Culvert
locations.description: The towpath crosses a stone culvert where a field drain empties into the river. Fox tracks mark the mud at its mouth. The towpath runs east and west.

locations.name: Quay Lane
locations.description: The towpath widens into a cart lane between stacked crates and coiled rope. Voices and the knock of loading carry from the quay to the west. The towpath back toward Bellwold runs east.

locations.name: North Quay
locations.description: Boats nose against the stone quay while crews load, mend and argue over the current. The ferry stage reaches into the river to the south. The customs house is west, the guild hall is north, and the towpath to Bellwold runs east.

locations.name: Customs House
locations.description: Ledgers fill the shelves of a narrow stone office, and a counter faces the quay door. A notice is pinned beside the door. The quay is east; Warehouse Row lies west.

locations.name: Guild Hall
locations.description: Long tables hold bills of lading and a chalked board of boats due and boats gone. Merchants talk in low, quick voices. The quay is south; the inn is west.

locations.name: Quayside Inn
locations.description: Crews and carters share the benches of a low, smoky common room. Wet coats steam by the hearth. The guild hall is east; the livestock market is west.

locations.name: Warehouse Row
locations.description: Timber warehouses stand shoulder to shoulder, their doors open on sacks, bales and barrels. Boat crews mend gear between loads. The customs house is east; the livestock market is north.

locations.name: Livestock Market
locations.description: Hurdle pens fill the open ground. The weekly market leaves trampled straw and the smell of animals long after it ends. The inn is east; Warehouse Row is south.

locations.name: South Landing
locations.description: A muddy landing on the south bank faces the ferry stage across the water. Boats put in here when the crews are carrying, but none waits now. A lane runs south.

locations.name: South Lane
locations.description: Low cottages and net sheds line a lane along Rillford’s south bank. The landing is north; a track leads east toward Bellwold’s Milepost Workshop.

locations.name: Landing Lane
locations.description: The track firms into a lane as it nears the river. Rillford’s roofs show to the west; the sedge track runs east.

locations.name: Sedge Track
locations.description: A narrow track runs through sedge and alder scrub. The Milepost Workshop is east; the track continues west toward Rillford.

locations.name: Far Bank Track
locations.description: The road climbs away from the bridge onto firmer ground. Lower Rill Bridge is north and the old mile marker south. A raised causeway threads east between reed beds.

locations.name: Old South Mile Marker
locations.description: A weathered stone marker stands beside the packed road. Most of its face is worn smooth; shallow grooves remain beneath the lichen. Far Bank Track is north; the unfinished road lies south, and a dirt track branches west.

locations.name: Mile Marker West Track
locations.description: The packed dirt bends west from the stone marker. Dry grass rasps against your boots, and a line of hazel leaves shivers ahead; the marker is east.

locations.name: Hazel Cut
locations.description: Hazel branches narrow the track, their leaves whispering over the road. A faint smell of woodsmoke drifts from the west; the Mile Marker West Track is east.

locations.name: Milepost Workshop
locations.description: Pale shavings curl across a scarred workbench beside a low, warm stove. A file rasps against metal; the hazel track runs east, and a sedge-lined track leads west toward Rillford’s south landing.

locations.name: Unfinished South Road
locations.description: The packed road ends at a shallow cut in the earth. Loose soil and ungraded ground extend beyond it, with no roofs visible. The old mile marker is north.

locations.name: Old Bell Tower Road
locations.description: The road climbs north, and Bellwold’s roofs drop from view behind a rise. The old tower’s outline stands against the sky. A narrow track branches east, where water glints beside the mill.

locations.name: Old Bell Tower
locations.description: Dust gathers in the seams between the stones. A bronze bell hangs motionless in a weathered frame; its clapper rests against its side.

locations.name: Abandoned Watermill
locations.description: The air by the channel is damp and cool. A slow wooden creak carries from the wheel, and water glints through the channel. A damp work ledger lies open on the desk. The tower road is west; the east track follows the channel.

locations.name: East Mill Track
locations.description: The road leaves the mill and runs east between shallow drainage channels. The abandoned watermill is west; a bend in the track lies east.

locations.name: East Road Bend
locations.description: The packed track curves around a low rise; the mill channel has vanished from view. A narrower path branches north toward the old church. East Mill Track is west; the road verge is east.

locations.name: North Church Track
locations.description: A narrow track climbs north between low banks of grass. Wind combs the grass as the road rises; East Road Bend is south and the church approach is north.

locations.name: Church Approach
locations.description: The track opens into bare ground before a dark timber doorway. Wind pushes dry leaves across the clearing; the entrance is north and the road returns south.

locations.name: Abandoned Church
locations.description: Dust powders the stone floor, and muted light falls through gaps in the roof. A narrow stair climbs toward a frame overhead; worn steps descend below.

locations.name: Church Belfry
locations.description: Wind cuts through the narrow belfry. A weathered frame hangs over the roofline, ringed by empty mounting holes; a cut length of rope taps against it. The stair leads down to the nave.

locations.name: Church Annex
locations.description: The steps descend into a low stone room. Damp darkens the mortar, and shallow shelves run along the walls. A locked iron door stands to the east; the stair leads up.

locations.name: Undercrypt Entry
locations.description: A low stone corridor begins beyond the iron door. Damp air carries the smell of earth; a shallow recess opens east, the passage runs north, and the annex lies west.

locations.name: Entry Recess
locations.description: The eastern recess ends at bare stone. A smooth layer of dust covers the floor; the corridor returns west.

locations.name: First Passage
locations.description: Rough stone presses close on either side, leaving space for two people to pass. Footsteps echo toward a fork north; the entry lies south.

locations.name: Three-Way Fork
locations.description: Three worn corridors meet beneath a cracked arch. Fine grit crunches underfoot; the first passage is south, the central hall north, and narrow branches open east and west.

locations.name: Blind Passage
locations.description: The western branch stops at a rough stone wall; loose grit gathers at its base. The fork lies east.

locations.name: Eastern Bend
locations.description: Stone walls curve north, where a colder draft threads through the passage. The fork lies west.

locations.name: Eastern Corridor
locations.description: Bootsteps echo down the straight corridor. The central hall opens west, the passage returns south, and a short branch ends east.

locations.name: Eastern Dead End
locations.description: The eastern corridor ends at a collapsed stone niche; fine dust lies undisturbed across the floor. The corridor is west.

locations.name: Central Hall
locations.description: A square chamber gathers the echoes of four passages. Cold air spills from the northern route; the fork lies south, with cross-corridors west and east.

locations.name: Western Corridor
locations.description: A narrow passage runs west from the central hall; a stone shelf juts from the northern wall into a shallow recess.

locations.name: Western Burial Recess
locations.description: A stone shelf juts from the wall of this shallow recess; dust gathers along its edge. The passage returns south.

locations.name: Northern Passage
locations.description: Cool air brushes through the straight passage. The central hall lies south; a larger junction waits north.

locations.name: Upper Junction
locations.description: Stone branches meet beneath an old lintel. Dust shifts in a draft; the northern passage is south, recesses open east and west, and a narrow route continues north.

locations.name: West Burial Recess
locations.description: A narrow stone shelf projects from the western wall, its surface dulled by dust. The junction lies east.

locations.name: East Burial Recess
locations.description: A cracked stone slab rests in the small recess, its surface scored with pale lines. The junction lies west.

locations.name: Reliquary Approach
locations.description: A squared arch rises ahead; cool, still air flows from a chamber to the north. The upper junction lies south.

locations.name: Church Reliquary
locations.description: Dry, still air hangs in the chamber. A narrow sword rests on a black stone shelf beneath a faded carving of a watchful hand.

locations.name: Eastern Road Verge
locations.description: The packed track ends at open ground beyond the bend. Grass pushes through the wheel ruts, and the eastern way is overgrown. The bend lies west.

locations.name: Reedbank Causeway
locations.description: Packed earth rises between the reeds. The bridge road lies west; a narrow causeway continues east beside shallow pools.

locations.name: Plank Run
locations.description: Short planks bridge the wet hollows between patches of firm ground. Loose reed bundles lie beside the path, which runs east and west.

locations.name: Muddy Causeway
locations.description: Broad cloven prints mark the pale mud beside a low bank. Reeds brush the raised path as it continues east and west.

locations.name: Sedge Causeway
locations.description: Sedge crowds both sides of the causeway. Raised roofs and a timber landing show through the stems to the east; the plank run returns west.

locations.name: Landing
locations.description: Wet posts ring a low landing beside a narrow channel to the north. A few small fish lie in a shallow basket. The causeway runs west, a roofed platform stands east, and boat sheds open south.

locations.name: Boat Sheds
locations.description: A shallow hull rests on wooden blocks beneath a reed roof. Pale curls of wood gather along its edge; the landing is north and planks lead east.

locations.name: Herb Platform
locations.description: Bundles of narrow leaves hang beneath the eaves, giving off a sharp green scent. Planks lead west to the landing, east toward the reeds, and south between raised houses.

locations.name: Territory Edge
locations.description: The planks end against a fringe of tall reeds. Dark water glints beyond them, with no marked passage across it. The only path returns west.

locations.name: South Platforms
locations.description: Raised boards pass between homes above patches of standing water. The herb platform is north and the boat sheds west; reeds close around the boards to the south.

locations.name: Sedge Reach
locations.description: Tall sedge leans over the water. The river bends west toward the alder-lined reaches; a narrow channel opens east between raised platforms.

locations.name: Mosswake Channel
locations.description: Low hulls lie beside timber posts on the southern bank. Water runs between sedge to the west and spreads east beside the platforms; the landing is south.

locations.name: Mosswake Open Water
locations.description: A broad patch of water catches the light between the platforms and reed beds. A notice is tied to a post. The channel returns west; reeds hem the other sides.
